tasks.answer: FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen (export FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen) from '@/features/flight-delay-compensation/batch-detail-screen'. Required prop: batchId. It is the batch compensation workspace covering standard, special and review steps; it needs query, auth and router providers and handles offline/conflict states.

No dedicated special-passenger (=special traveler) list component exists in the feature layer: the only hit is the generic TravelerBookingListScreen (export TravelerBookingListScreen) from '@/features/traveler-bookings/booking-list-screen', required prop navigate, optional initialStatus. It is a paginated traveler booking list with search and filters, permission-gated queries/actions. Use it for special passengers (optionally pre-setting initialStatus/filters); there is no special-traveler-specific variant to import.

auth.PasswordInput (export PasswordInput) from '@/features/auth/password-input'; no required props. It is a password field with show/hide labels and a form-field error. Errors are not rendered by the input itself: the component must be used inside UiFormField, and the error is passed as a string that the field wrapper displays.

Both live in the shared-ui module '@/components/business/mobile': business.SearchBar (export SearchBar) — required value, placeholder, onChange; onFilter adds the filter icon button; and business.FilterSheet (export FilterSheet) — required visible, title, children, onClose; reset/confirm actions, onConfirm runs before the sheet closes. Wire SearchBar's onFilter to open FilterSheet.

common.AuthRecoveryDialog (export AuthRecoveryDialog) from '@/components/common/auth-recovery-dialog'; no required props. It is a global dialog that subscribes to the auth recovery store and lazily renders its view, so mount it once near the app root (global mount, not per-page); it renders null while no recovery event is pending. The inner view is common.AuthRecoveryDialogView (required detail) which the dialog mounts itself.

notes: 5 searches (one per task, --details plus the mandated --layer) and 1 get (bookings.TravelerBookingListScreen, task 2) to confirm no special-traveler variant.
